lean_source.text:
@[ext] structure Point (R : Type*) where
  p : R
  s : R
  u : R
  f : R
  j : R

namespace Point

def x (q : Point R) : R := q.s ^ 2 + q.u ^ 3 + q.p ^ 2 * q.f
def equation (q : Point R) : R :=
  q.x ^ 2 * q.f - (1 + 2 * q.s * q.x) * q.j - q.p ^ 2 * q.j ^ 2 - q.p * q.u

lean_source.text:
/-- A finite exponential shift fixing `p`, `x`, `y`, `z` and translating `u` by `-p²w`. -/
def shift (q : Point R) (w : R) : Point R :=

  ⟨q.p, q.s + q.p ^ 2 * q.x * k, q.u - q.p ^ 2 * w,
    q.f - (2 * q.s * q.x + 1) * k - q.p ^ 2 * q.x ^ 2 * k ^ 2,
    q.j - q.x ^ 2 * k⟩

lean_source.text:
noncomputable def determinantRelation : P k 5 := X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1
noncomputable def idealC : Ideal (P k 5) := Ideal.span {determinantRelation k}
abbrev C := P k 5 ⧸ idealC k
/-- Determinant-ring variables `a,d,b,c,u`, in this order. -/
noncomputable def cX (i : Fin 5) : C k := Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) (X i)

noncomputable def sB : B k := bX k 1 - bX k 0 * (bX k 0 + bX k 3 ^ 2)
noncomputable def f0 : B k := bX k 0 - sB k ^ 2 + bX k 3 ^ 2
noncomputable def g0 : B k := bX k 2 - sB k * bX k 0
noncomputable def I : Ideal (B k) := Ideal.span {f0 k, g0 k}
noncomputable def v : C k := cX k 0 ^ 3 * cX k 2 + cX k 0 ^ 2 * cX k 4 ^ 2 - cX k 1 ^ 2

open_problems.title: First Vénéreau polynomial: is v1 = y + x(xz + y(yu + z^2)) a coordinate of ℂ[x,y,z,u]?
open_problems.statement: Is v1 a variable (coordinate) of ℂ[x,y,z,u]? It is a hyperplane and a 1-stable coordinate; v2 is a coordinate (Lewis), v_n (n ≥ 3) are ℂ[x]-coordinates (Vénéreau).
open_problems.reference: D. Lewis, 'Vénéreau-type polynomials as potential counterexamples', JPAA 217 (2013), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpaa.2012.09.018 (arXiv:1007.2230); Kaliman–Zaidenberg arXiv math/0308191; Blanc–Poloni, Ann. Fac. Sci. Toulouse (2022), https://doi.org/10.5802/afst.1724
open_problems.obstruction_match: strong: 049 refuted SCC with a Vénéreau-shaped degree-5 polynomial using exactly 047's obstruction (filtration by the distinguished variable, graded LND killing an element of the ideal I, SL2-torsor principalization, rigidity). The question 'is this one-stable coordinate a coordinate' is the same as 049's.
open_problems.adaptation_sketch: Present ℂ[x,y,z,u] as a hypersurface P/(H') in which x is the distinguished element (as 049 does for p), take the x-adic filtration, compute gr and the centre I, look for a torsor on which I becomes principal, and try the rigidity argument. If the associated graded has a trivializing torsor with v nonsquare-type rigidity, v1 is not a coordinate.
open_problems.payoff: high (settles a 20-year-old problem; refines the Abhyankar–Sathaye picture)

lean_feasibility.statable_with: OAI.StableCoordinate.IsCoordinate (049 Definitions.lean) applied to v1 ∈ MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℂ
lean_feasibility.formal_proof_to_compare: 049's f_not_coordinate (NonCoordinate.lean:24) is the analogous formal proof

open_problems.title: Is the Koras–Russell cubic cylinder X × A^1 isomorphic to A^4?
open_problems.statement: For X = {x + x^2 y + z^2 + t^3 = 0}, is X × A^1 ≅ A^4? (ML(X × A^1) = ℂ by Dubouloz.) A yes would be a 3-dimensional ZCP counterexample.
open_problems.reference: A. Dubouloz, 'The cylinder over the Koras–Russell cubic threefold has a trivial Makar-Limanov invariant', Transform. Groups 14 (2009), arXiv:0807.4085
open_problems.obstruction_match: the cylinder half only: 047 makes A[w] polynomial by an explicit residual-coordinate transfer (LND exponential + determinant-1 change). The non-polynomiality half is already known for X.
open_problems.adaptation_sketch: Look for p ∈ ℂ[X] (e.g. x) such that x is a residual coordinate of the cylinder and X[x^-1] is trivial, then imitate Cylinder.decode/encode. KR's x-fibration has a non-reduced fibre, which is exactly what blocked earlier attempts; 047's p has reduced fibres A^3, so the analogy is weak.

open_problems.title: Makar-Limanov invariant of the 047 fourfold, and the ML characterization of A^4
open_problems.statement: Compute ML(X) for 047's X = Spec A. If ML(X) = ℂ, X is a smooth contractible affine fourfold with trivial ML invariant and X × A^1 ≅ A^5 that is not A^4, refuting the dimension-4 form of the 'ML-trivial + contractible ⇒ affine space' characterization question.
open_problems.reference: Kaliman's characterization question (see Gupta ICM 2022 survey, https://doi.org/10.4171/ICM2022/151; Dubouloz arXiv:0807.4085 discusses its dimension-4 status via KR × A^1)
open_problems.status: open (ML(X) not computed in 047; the 047 proof only shows no LND of A kills a positive-degree element of the degeneration)
open_problems.obstruction_match: same witness, different invariant; 047's positive-invariant obstruction is a filtered ML-type statement
open_problems.adaptation_sketch: Exhibit LNDs of A: restrictions of LNDs of P that preserve (H) (e.g. ∂-type derivations built from the residual coordinate) and intersect their kernels. If p is in every kernel, ML(X) ⊇ ℂ[p] ≠ ℂ (then X is also distinguished from A^4 by ML, a shorter non-polynomiality proof).
open_problems.payoff: medium–high either way (trivial ML: refutes a characterization; nontrivial ML: much shorter proof of 047's hard half — a speedup measurement in itself)

open_problems.title: Dubouloz–Ghosh A^1-contractible varieties: are their cylinders affine spaces?
open_problems.statement: For the smooth A^1-contractible varieties of dimension n ≥ 4 constructed by Dubouloz–Ghosh (non-isomorphic to A^n), is X × A^1 ≅ A^{n+1}?
open_problems.obstruction_match: cylinder half: needs an explicit residual-coordinate trivialization of the kind 047 builds
open_problems.adaptation_sketch: Find a distinguished function p with X[p^-1] trivial over ℂ[p^±] and reduced A^{n-1} fibres, then a residual coordinate in X × A^1 over ℂ[p]; the El Kahoui–Ouali criterion then gives X × A^1 ≅ A^{n+1}. 047's explicit decode/encode is the template.
open_problems.payoff: high (new ZCP counterexamples in many dimensions, complementing the n ≥ 5 question)

lean_feasibility.statable_with: explicit quotient of MvPolynomial if the equations are explicit (they are hypersurface-type in loc. cit.)

open_problems.title: Abhyankar–Sathaye embedding conjecture in A^3
open_problems.statement: Is every closed embedding A^2 ↪ A^3 rectifiable (equivalently: f ∈ ℂ[x,y,z] with ℂ[x,y,z]/(f) ≅ ℂ^[2] is a coordinate)?
open_problems.reference: Kraft, 'Challenging problems on affine n-space', Sém. Bourbaki 802 (1995); 049's Sep-24 manuscript refutes the ambient-dimension-4 case by a different (critical-point) method
open_problems.obstruction_match: weak: SCC is true in 3 variables (Shpilrain–Yu via Kaliman 2002), so 049-style stable-noncoordinate witnesses cannot exist there
open_problems.adaptation_sketch: Not promising; included because the brief asks for any-field matches. Expect failure.

lean_feasibility.statable_with: MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ quotient ≃ₐ MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ ⇒ coordinate

open_problems.title: Is the 047 fourfold X biholomorphic to ℂ^4?
open_problems.statement: X is algebraically exotic with algebraic cylinder ℂ^5; is X analytically ℂ^4 (as for the open analytic question on the Koras–Russell cubic)?
open_problems.reference: analytic exotic-structure questions, see Kraft's Bourbaki survey and Gupta ICM 2022
open_problems.obstruction_match: same witness; holomorphic triviality of p: X → ℂ over ℂ^* plus Oka-type arguments might give an analytic trivialization
open_problems.adaptation_sketch: Use the A^3-fibration p with trivialization over p ≠ 0 and the special fibre A^3, and attempt an analytic residual-coordinate argument (Oka–Grauert for the fibration).

release_reuse.summary: Exactly one in-release reuse: family 049's Oct-5 manuscript ('A stable coordinate that is not a coordinate in four variables'). It reuses the DESIGN of H, not the theorem. 049's Sep-24 manuscript (noncoordinate with A^3 zero fibre) uses an unrelated design (cusp relation x^2 + y^3 = hs and a critical-point obstruction). No other release preprint cites 047 (grep of all preprints for 'Cancellation2026' / the title). No other Lean dir imports OAI.Algebra.AffineCancellation (grep of lean/OAI).
what_changed: quadric identity: xy - z(z+1) = p^2 (H + p u)  [twist p^3 u]  →  xy - z(z+1) = p (H + u)  [twist p u]; same quadric B = k[x,y,z,u]/(xy - z(z+1)), same y = s + x(x - φ(u)), z = sx + p^m J

role of A: in 047 A ≇ ℂ^[4] is the point; in 049 A ≅ ℂ^[4] (new determinant-1 matrix change M' = (I - 2 n e^T) M, which needs the QUADRATIC u-term) and the target is the distinguished element p, shown to be a 1-stable coordinate but not a coordinate
degeneration: gr A = R[τ, I/τ^2]  →  G = B[τ, I/τ]
torsor: same SL2 ring k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac - bd - 1); principal generator v = a^3 b - a^2 u^3 - d^2  →  v = a^3 b + a^2 u^2 - d^2
rigidity: Mason–Stothers abc + '-u^3 is not a square'  →  factorization of the top auxiliary part as (au - d)(au + d), no abc needed
Lean: 049 re-formalizes everything (118 files, 15,542 lines; imports Mathlib only, including RingTheory.PicardGroup), sharing no code with 047 (55 files, 5,573 lines, which avoided Picard groups)
release_reuse.design_or_theorem: Design. 047's main theorem implies SCC failure only in ambient dimension 5 (its own corollary); 049's ambient-dimension-4 result does not follow from it, and 049's A is a polynomial ring, so 049 cannot be obtained by applying 047's theorem. What 049 takes from 047 is the template (Danielewski-type twist of the SL2/T quadric written as a residual coordinate H in k[p,s,u,F,J]) and the obstruction pipeline (filtration by p, graded LND killing an element of the centre I, principalization on the SL2 torsor, lift, rigidity). 049 says so: it 'adapts the construction in [Cancellation2026, Sections 2–6]' (01-introduction.tex:47; 02-construction.tex:7-8).
caveats: Same producer, 12 days later, explicitly citing 047: this is adaptation by the author, not independent rediscovery; it shows the design transfers, not that it is easy to find.
The transfer needed a genuinely new ingredient (the determinant-preserving matrix change making A polynomial), so 049 is 'design + one new idea', not mechanical re-instantiation.
Reuse is of the whole package (H + C2–C4 of the novelty analysis), not of H alone; H by itself (a fixed polynomial) is never reused verbatim.
Both results are unrefereed; neither Lean development was compiled here.
release_reuse.verdict: Genuine in-release design reuse refuting a different conjecture (SCC/Abhyankar–Sathaye in ambient dimension 4). Counts toward 'device reuse' for a witness item under the brief's rule, with the caveats above.

negative_controls.title: 049's own A_049 = P/(H_049) IS a polynomial ring (OAI.StableCoordinate.polynomialPresentation)
negative_controls.why: Same template with parameters (m,j,φ) = (1,0,-u^2) gives A ≅ ℂ^[4]: the design does NOT always produce a cancellation counterexample. top5.argument: The only measurable, Lean-statable target where the 047 design is known to transfer: the comparator exists, 049's own formal proof (15,542 lines, no code shared with 047) gives a baseline, and the paper states that it adapts 047 §§2–6. Run the prover on principal_package with and without OAI/Algebra/AffineCancellation (and with a parametrized refactor of 047's pipeline). Caveat: the transfer needed one new idea (the determinant-1 matrix change), so success with 047 available measures 'design given' vs 'design withheld', which is exactly the 047 Test-4 arm D vs arm O contrast.

top5.target: Parametric reach of the H-design (open; includes the 049-A negative control)
top5.argument: The cleanest device-reuse test for a witness: does the template produce further witnesses? Statable now as MainStatement with symbolic (m, j, φ); one instance is known positive (047), one known negative for cancellation (049's A is polynomial). New instances (e.g. φ = u^5, twist p^2 u) would be other witnesses from the same design.

The strongest external open problem with the same obstruction: a Vénéreau-shaped one-stable coordinate whose coordinate status is open, exactly the situation 049 resolved with 047's pipeline. Statable now with 049's IsCoordinate. Low success probability (0.15) but a hit would be strong evidence for a reusable device; pair with the Lewis v2 negative control.

top5.target: ZCP over ℂ in dimensions n ≥ 5 (open)
top5.argument: 047's own remark shows dimension 4 does not propagate upward, so a dimension-5 witness needs the design again (Gupta needed a second family in characteristic p). Statable now; tests whether the design survives extra variables, where extra partial-derivative LNDs threaten the obstruction.

Known theorems, statable now, with no formal proof anywhere; they measure whether 047's GENERIC LND infrastructure (Rees degeneration, homogeneous leading LND) speeds proofs. Any speedup here should be credited to infrastructure, not to H — useful as a contrast to targets 1–4.
